hardwareHubs.note: MakeHaven operates a community makerspace at 770 Chapel Street.
Hartford is the base of Pratt & Whitney's parent company and of the CONNSTEP MEP center at 350 Church Street.

makerspaces.name: MakeHaven
makerspaces.note: Community makerspace with CNC milling, laser cutters, many 3D printers, a resin printer and an electronics bench with oscilloscopes.

specialties.name: Aerospace
specialties.note: Sikorsky runs the state's largest plant in Stratford and Pratt & Whitney makes jet engines.

specialties.name: Submarine building
specialties.note: Electric Boat, a General Dynamics division, builds submarines in Groton.

specialties.name: Pharmaceuticals
specialties.note: Boehringer Ingelheim manufactures drugs and has its U.S. headquarters in Ridgefield.

support.name: CONNSTEP
support.note: Connecticut's NIST MEP center, helping small and mid-sized manufacturers with operations, strategic growth, cybersecurity and sustainability.

support.name: Manufacturing Innovation Fund (CT DECD)
support.note: State fund for advanced manufacturing, with a voucher program run by CCAT that offers matching grants of $10,000 to $50,000 including for prototype development.
